m: 1. रु cl. 2. P. (Dhātup. xxiv, 24; cf. Pāṇ. vii, 3, 95) रौति or रवीति (Ved. also रुवति and रवति, ˚ते; p. रुवत्, रवत्, रवमाण, रवाण; pf. रुराव, MBh.; रुरुविरे, Br.; aor. अरावीत्, RV.; Prec. रूयात् Gr.; fut. रविता or रोता, ib.; रविष्यति, ib.; inf. रवितुम्, ib., रोतुम्, Kāv.), to roar, bellow, howl, yelp, cry aloud, RV. &c. &c.; to make any noise or sound, sing (as birds), hum (as bees), MBh.; Kāv. &c.; (रौति) to praise, Naigh. iii, 14 : Caus. रावयति (aor. अरूरुवत् with the sense of the Intens. BhP.; or अरीरवत्, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 80, Sch.), to cause to bellow or roar, cause an uproar, ĀśvŚr.; MBh. &c. : Desid. of Caus. रिरावयिषति Gr. : Desid. रुरूषति, ib. : Intens. (Ved.) रोरवीति (p. रोरुवत् and रोरुवाण) or (ep.) रोरूयते, ˚ति or (Gr.) रोरोति. to bellow or roar &c. loudly, scream aloud, vociferate.
रु [cf. Gk. ὠρύομαι; Lat. raucus; Angl.Sax. rŷn.]
2. रु m. (only L.) sound, noise
fear, alarm
war, battle.

3. रु cl. 1. Ā. (Dhātup. xxii, 63) रवते (only राविषम्, RV. x, 86, 5; रुरुविषे, अरविष्ट, अरोष्ट, Vop.) to break or dash to pieces, RV. (Dhātup. also ‘to go; to kill; to be angry; to speak’) : Intens. (only p. रोरुवत्) to break, shatter, RV. i, 54, 1; 5.

1. रुध् (cf. √ 1. रुह्, of which this seems to be only another form) cl. 1. P. रोधति, to sprout, shoot, grow (only रोधति, RV. viii, 43, 6; and विरोधत्, i, 67, 9; accord. to some also p. रुधत्, i, 179, 4, in नदस्य रुधतः कामः, ‘the desire of the growing reed’ i.e. of the membrum virile; others, ‘of the husband who keeps me away’, fr. √ 2. रुध्; cf. also नद).

2. रुध् cl. 7. P. Ā. (Dhātup. xxix, 1) रुणद्धि, रुन्द्धे (1. pl. -रुध्मस्, AV.; रुन्धति, ˚ते, Br. &c.; रोधति, MBh. pf. रुरोध, रुरुधे, RV. &c. &c.; रुरुन्धतुः, MBh.; aor. अरौत्, AV.; अरौत्सीत्, Br. &c.; रोत्सीस्, Up.; अरुत्सि, अरुद्ध, Br.; Up.; अरौत्सि, AitBr.; अरोधम्, RV.; अरुध्म, MaitrS.; p. रुधत् cf. √ 1. रुध्; अरुधत्, RV. &c. &c.; Prec. रुध्यात्, Kāv.; fut. रोद्धा Gr.; रोत्स्यति, ˚ते, Br. &c. inf. रोद्धुम् or रोधितुम्, MBh.; रोद्धोस्, Br.; ind.p. रुद्ध्वा, MBh. &c.; -रुध्य, RV. &c. &c.; -रुन्ध्य, MBh.; -रुधम्, AV.; Br.; -रुन्धम्, Br.; -रोधम्, ib.), to obstruct, check, arrest, stop, restrain, prevent, keep back, withhold, RV. (always with न), &c. &c.; to avert, keep off, repel, Bhaṭṭ. (cf. रुधत् under √ 1. रुध्); to shut, lock up, confine in (loc.), Mn.; MBh. &c. (accord. to Vop. also with double acc.); to besiege, blockade, invest, Pat.; MBh. &c.; to close, block up (a path), R.; to cover, conceal, veil, obscure, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to stop up, fill, ib.; to lay (dust), Ragh.; to touch, move (the heart), Bālar.; to torment, harass, R.; to lose, be deprived of (acc.), TS.; ŚBr.; to tear, rend asunder (?), AV. xix, 29, 3 : Caus. रोधयति (ep. also ˚ते and रुन्धयति ; aor. अरूरुधत्; Pass. रोध्यते), to stop, arrest, MBh.; to cause to be confined by (acc.), Pañcar.; to cause to be besieged by (instr.), Ragh.; to close (with a cover or lid), Bhpr.; to fetter, enchain, influence, BhP.; to oppress, torment, harass, MBh.; R. : Desid. रोरुत्सते (Br.), ˚ति (MBh.), to wish to obstruct &c.: Intens. रोरुध्यते, रोरोद्धि, to obstruct intensely or repeatedly &c. Gr. (only रोरुधः, R. ii, 58, 20.)
3. रुध् (ifc.) impeding, holding (see कर-र्˚).
4. रुध् prob. a root of this form once existed with a meaning ‘to be red’.
a: रुध् — {vI.v} {c7c} U. (रुणद्धि, रुंद्धे, रुरोध, रुरुधे, अरुधत्-अरौत्सीत्-अरुद्ध, रोत्स्यति-ते, रोद्धुं, रुद्ध; desid. रुरुत्सति-ते) 1 To obstruct, stop, arrest, check, oppose, hinder; impede, prevent इदं रुणद्धि मां पद्ममंतःकूजितषट्पदं V. 4. 21; रुद्धालोके नरपतिपथे Me. 37, 91; प्राणापानगती रुद्ध्वा Bg. 4. 29. --2 To hold up, preserve, sustain (from falling); आशाबंधः कुसुमसदृशं प्रायशो ह्यंगनानां सद्यःपाति प्रणयि हृदयं विप्रयोगे रुणद्धि Me. 10. --3 (a) To shut up, lock or block up, close up, shut or close; (with loc., but sometimes with two acc.); Bk. 6. 35; व्रजं रुणद्धि गां Sk. (b) To surround, fence or hem in. --4 To bind, confine; व्यालं बालमृणालतंतुभिरसौ रोद्धुं समुज्जृभते Bh. 2. 6. --5 To besiege, invest, blockade; रुंधंतु वारणघटा नगरं मदीयाः Mu. 4. 17; अरुणद्यवनः साकेतं or माध्यमिकान् Mbh.; Bk. 14. 29. --6 To hide, cover, obscure, conceal. --7 To oppress, torment, afflict excessively. --Caus. 1 To cause to stop, detain, impede, obstruct. --2 To fetter, confine, chain. --3 To oppress, torment, harass. {vII.v} {c1c} P. (रोधति) To grow, germinate, cf. रुह्.

(accord. to others ‘red, shining, glittering’, fr. a √ रुद् or रुध् connected with रुधिर; others ‘strong, having or bestowing strength or power’, fr. a √ रुद् = वृद्, वृध्; native authorities give also the following meanings, ‘driving away evil’; ‘running about and roaring’, fr. रु + द्र = 2. द्रु; ‘praiseworthy, to be praised’; ‘a praiser, worshipper’ = स्तोतृ, Naigh. iii, 16)

रुद्र m. ‘Roarer or Howler’, N. of the god of tempests and father and ruler of the Rudras and Maruts (in the Veda he is closely connected with Indra and still more with Agni, the god of fire, which, as a destroying agent, rages and crackles like the roaring storm, and also with Kāla or Time the all-consumer, with whom he is afterwards identified; though generally represented as a destroying deity, whose terrible shafts bring death or disease on men and cattle, he has also the epithet शिव, ‘benevolent’ or ‘auspicious’, and is even supposed to possess healing powers from his chasing away vapours and purifying the atmosphere; in the later mythology the word शिव, which does not occur as a name in the Veda, was employed, first as an euphemistic epithet and then as a real name for Rudra, who lost his special connection with storms and developed into a form of the disintegrating and reintegrating principle; while a new class of beings, described as eleven [or thirty-three] in number, though still called Rudras, took the place of the original Rudras or Maruts: in VP. i, 7, Rudra is said to have sprung from Brahmā's forehead, and to have afterwards separated himself into a figure half male and half female, the former portion separating again into the 11 Rudras, hence these later Rudras are sometimes regarded as inferior manifestations of Śiva, and most of their names, which are variously given in the different Purāṇas, are also names of Śiva ; those of the VāyuP. are Ajaikapād, Ahir-budhnya, Hara, Nirṛta, Īśvara, Bhuvana, Aṅgāraka, Ardha-ketu, Mṛtyu, Sarpa, Kapālin; accord. to others the Rudras are represented as children of Kaśyapa and Surabhi or of Brahmā and Surabhi or of Bhūta and Su-rūpā; accord. to VP. i, 8, Rudra is one of the 8 forms of Śiva; elsewhere he is reckoned among the Dik-pālas as regent of the north-east quarter), RV. &c. &c. (cf. RTL. 75 &c.)

s: strI, (rudrasya vIRA .) vIRABedaH । yaTA, -- “daRqaH syAdrudravIRAyA muzwyekAdaSasammitaH । BramadaNguzWAgramitaM SuziraM tasya kIrttitam ॥ daRqasyoBayato jYeyaM kAMsyasaMvarakadvayam । paScAt saMvarakaYcAtra CatrIkftaSiro Bavet ॥ daRqasya vezwanaM sArdDaM paYcANgulamivoditam । tanmitA laKarI tasyAH karttavyA sundarAkftiH ॥ kakuBo rudravIRAyAstriSirAH parikIrttitaH । UrdDve Sirasi dAtavyA lohapatrI samanvitA ॥ mUlatantrI tadupari tasyA lOhI tataH param । dakziRe Sirasi nyasyet SrutitantrIdbayaM kramAt ॥ evantu kakuBaM tatra vIRAdaRqe niveSayet । dbyaNguloccamUrdDvaSiro'NguzWamAtrantu pArSvakam ॥ saptANgulAntaraM tasmAttanmUlaYca niveSayet । anyaM tataScatustriMSadaNgulAntaramAkzipet ॥ azwAdaSANgulamuKaM cakra vE cArugarBakam । daRqaM samunnataM kAntaM varttulaM tumbayugmakam ॥ Onnatye kiYcidADikyamalayaSca praSasyate । ardDANgulAntaraM paScAttumbaraM sTApayedbuDaH ॥ daRqapfzWa ranDramekaM sTApayecca samantataH । lohANkuSantu karttavyaM varttulaM paNkajAkfti ॥ tadbanDanaM guRaM tasmin vezwabanDe niveSayet । etatparAyAM mowinyAM vezwaranDrANkuSaM kzipet ॥ tanmowanIvfttaranDrasadfSaM daRqaranDrakam । suyantrite tu tatrEva baDnIyAnmuKyatantrikAm ॥ tAvacca BrAmayet pUrvvAM mowanIYca SanEH SanEH । na yAvadeti svasTAnaM tantrI yantraviSAradaH ॥ asyAstvazwAdaSa proktAH SArikAH pUrvvasUriBiH । tAsAM bfhattarA azwO daSa kzudrAH prakIrttitAH ॥ etAstu tAravAdinyastizWanti padikopari । vitastimAtrapadikANguzWoccApyasya garBakaH ॥ tAvat SUnyastu karttavyo yaTA daRqe sTiro Bavet । madanasya ca sikTasya yogena sudfQIkftA ॥ bfhatInAYca SArIRAM svanano'yaM talakramAt । etAstu sarvvAvayavEH kaTitAstryaNgulA buDEH ॥ sTApya daRqasya tAH pfzWe yaTArAgasvaraM punaH । madanasya ca sikTasya yogena sudfQIkftAH ॥ sarvvAsAM lohakalikA mastake syuH suyantritAH । ekANguloccAH kzudrAH syuriti SArIvinirRayaH ॥ evaM vinirmmitA rudravIRA janamanoharA । asyAM SikzA tu karttavyA dAkziRAtyopadeSataH ॥” iti saNgItanArAyaRaH ॥

। piNgale cArupadmAkzi durBikzaM narmmadAtawe ॥ 11 ॥ gomahizyo vinaSyanti ye cAnye nawanarttakAH । vAsavo varzate devi SasyaYca nahi jAyate ॥ tilasarzapamAzAdikArpAsAnAM mahArGatA । gomahizyaH sarvvaBUtaM carAcaram । deSaBaNgaSca durBikzaM kzaye saMkzIyate prajA ॥ sOrAzwre mAlave deSe dakziRe koNkaRe taTA । durBikzaM jAyate GoraM kzaye saMvatsare priye ॥ kOmudIcarmmanadyoSca
